name: Memphis–Shelby 2024–25 TNReady district comparison
model_scope: Memphis–Shelby independent 2024–25 grade-school models use exact NCES LEA 4700148 / CCD TN-00792 / EDC 792 identities. All 154 audited operational pure lower offered and reconciled enrolled grade profiles remain searchable. Four specifically named shared-time schools retain unresolved enrolled-versus-served income/outcome attribution and have unavailable comparison metrics. Original TNReady regular All Students G38 Levels 3–4 published rates and own reported individual direct certification / same-year school membership support separate fixed 142 Math, 147 ELA and independently fitted 142 Combined models. Charters, income extremes and influence remain included. The school-specific note does not certify attribution coverage at nonlisted schools. Native-only, high, mixed, primary and other excluded configurations remain outside. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; all sampling intervals are unavailable.
map_source: School coordinates and district boundaries are unavailable in the audited Memphis–Shelby source release.

income_definition.label: Reported individual direct certification / school membership
income_definition.definition: 2024–25 reported CCD Final 2a individual Direct Certification Education Unit Total divided by that school’s own reported same-year Membership Education Unit Total, including pre-K where enrolled. This benefits/status measure is an economic disadvantage proxy, not full household-income FRPL, Tennessee economic disadvantage or universal/CEP meal receipt. Both counts require Reported flags; masks, missing or derived counts, other-year income and tested-subgroup denominators never substitute. Certification and Medicaid/reporting coverage vary and completeness is unknown. Four named shared-time schools retain their original raw ratios but usable income and proficiency are unavailable because enrolled-versus-served attribution is unresolved.

policy.population: Pure lower grade-configuration source profiles require an operational exact CCD identity, complete unadjusted reported offered flags with a grade 3–8 offer, no offered 9–13/UG/AE, reported positive own membership with reconciled lower-grade subtotals, positive reported enrolled grade 3–8 and only explicit zero outside PK–8. policy.income: Own reported CCD Final 2a Direct Certification Education Unit Total divided by own reported positive same-year Membership Education Unit Total. Preserve benefits/status-based individual certification, including pre-K where enrolled; this is not full household-income FRPL, state economic disadvantage or universal/CEP meal receipt. policy.assessment: Original EDC v3.1 SEA-sourced TNReady regular school All Students native G38 aggregate grades 3–8, Levels 3–4. Use only exact original ProficientOrAbove_percent in 0–1; ranges, suppression and missingness remain unavailable, never midpoint or zero. EDC may sum performance-level percentages within the same native total; do not average grades, reconstruct more precise count ratios or pool subgroup/district rows.
policy.counts: EDC tested and proficiency/level counts remain unverified raw evidence and may be constructed from other data. All valid-score counts, variances and interval endpoints stay null; ten-valid-scored floor uncertified. CCD membership/direct certification, participation and federal 95% measures never substitute for valid-score denominators. Existing count holds are retained without repeated failed investigations.
policy.shared_time: Original Final 2a Tennessee CCD-0054 note says some or all students receive services at a school while enrolled in a separate school of record. Preserve all named NCES records and exact note pointers. Four named pure-lower profiles retain raw DC/member ratios and G38 rates but have explicit unresolved enrolled-versus-served attribution holds, separate from unheld usable inputs. A plausible ratio or DC<=membership does not clear this hold. This is a source-attribution exclusion, never a diagnostic or influence exclusion. The note identifies named schools; it does not establish a whole-LEA warning or certify attribution coverage at nonlisted campuses.
policy.suppression: Keep explicit zero, suppressed/ranged, nonreported/derived and missing rows separate. No complementing ranges or backfilling another year. Native-only NCES IDs have no inferred directory, income or corrected identity.
policy.combined: Equal mean of exact usable original Math and ELA native rates with own same-year direct-certification ratio, not proficiency in both. A future Combined model must use its own fit and studentization; no model is created by this source audit.
policy.limitations: Retain original charter, alternative, school-type, virtual, grade disagreement and shared-time evidence without program, admissions, provider, geometry, causal-effect or quality inference. School/district enrollment differences do not establish a cause or supply score denominators. Single 2024–25 snapshot and original EDC source-business-rule limits remain.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct original complete CCD offered and own enrolled grade scope, exact operational NCES/native ownership, reported individual direct certification / reported own membership, and native regular School All Students G38 Math/ELA published-rate tokens. Preserve all 154 pure lower source profiles and raw evidence for the four specifically named CCD-0054 attribution holds; only unheld usable rates select the 142 Math, 147 ELA and 142 Combined members. Native-only Caldwell-Guthrie remains unjoined; school-specific shared-time notes do not certify nonlisted coverage. No diagnostics, charter, income extreme, unverified count, grade average or old statewide result selects inputs.
policy.models: Separate unweighted centered Memphis–Shelby 2024–25 grade-school Math, ELA and Combined OLS. Combined independently fits the paired 142 original-rate means with its own residual scale, explicit deletions and external studentization; unequal ELA membership prohibits averaging full subject coefficients or studentized scores. No enrollment weights, shrinkage, causal-effect claims, fit-driven exclusion, clamping or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit and N−3 residual degrees of freedom, independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and prediction sensitivity over observed income are descriptive; they never remove schools or cap predictions.
policy.intervals: All valid-score counts, sampling variances and endpoints are null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor remains uncertified. A zero variance vector supplied to the shared fitter is solely a point-estimate computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.

details: Memphis–Shelby independent 2024–25 grade-school models use exact NCES LEA 4700148 / CCD TN-00792 / EDC 792 identities. All 154 audited operational pure lower offered and reconciled enrolled grade profiles remain searchable. Four specifically named shared-time schools retain unresolved enrolled-versus-served income/outcome attribution and have unavailable comparison metrics. Original TNReady regular All Students G38 Levels 3–4 published rates and own reported individual direct certification / same-year school membership support separate fixed 142 Math, 147 ELA and independently fitted 142 Combined models. Charters, income extremes and influence remain included. The school-specific note does not certify attribution coverage at nonlisted schools. Native-only, high, mixed, primary and other excluded configurations remain outside. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; all sampling intervals are unavailable.

Three separate unweighted OLS fits reproduce all 431 results and explicit deleted fits. Combined independently fits the equal mean of original Math and ELA rates with its own residual scale and studentization. ELA includes five additional schools, so full subject coefficients and studentized scores cannot be averaged. Filters never refit models. Associations do not establish causal school effectiveness or overall quality.

Use original EDC v3.1 school TNReady regular All Students G38 aggregate grades 3–8 proficiency at Levels 3–4. Published fractional tokens are converted to percentages without rebuilding more precise count ratios or averaging grades. Ranged, suppressed and missing rates remain unavailable, never zero. Original EDC source-business-rule limits remain.

2024–25 reported CCD Final 2a individual Direct Certification Education Unit Total divided by that school’s own reported same-year Membership Education Unit Total, including pre-K where enrolled. This benefits/status measure is an economic disadvantage proxy, not full household-income FRPL, Tennessee economic disadvantage or universal/CEP meal receipt. Both counts require Reported flags; masks, missing or derived counts, other-year income and tested-subgroup denominators never substitute. Certification and Medicaid/reporting coverage vary and completeness is unknown. Four named shared-time schools retain their original raw ratios but usable income and proficiency are unavailable because enrolled-versus-served attribution is unresolved.

CCD membership/direct certification cover the school’s reported population, including pre-K where present; native G38 proficiency covers grades 3–8. The source identifies 13 Memphis schools with shared-time status. Four overlap the pure lower profiles: Germantown Middle, Woodstock Middle School, Treadwell Middle School and White Station Middle. Their enrolled-versus-served attribution is unresolved and their comparison results remain unavailable. A plausible DC/membership ratio does not clear the hold. Nine other named schools are outside the grade-school scope; nonlisted attribution coverage is not certified.

The exact CCD district reports 111,124 students while its operational school totals sum 111,125. The difference −1 is not assigned a cause and never replaces an individual school’s own income denominator. Native-only Caldwell-Guthrie has no matching same-year directory identity or income and remains unjoined.

Original EDC tested and performance-level counts remain unverified valid-score denominators and may be constructed from other source information. Own CCD membership, direct certification, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor remains uncertified. External studentization uses every deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom; it supplies no enrollment adjustment or shrinkage.

Full and all 431 deleted designs have rank two and positive finite scales. Largest deleted prediction changes over observed income: Math 1.916088; ELA 1.962594; Combined 2.003385 percentage points. All 40 Math/Combined and 41 ELA charters, income extremes and influential Maxine Smith STEAM Academy remain included. Diagnostic flags never remove schools or clamp predictions.

The complete linked source retains 3,368 needed original records and 80,349 typed cells, full primary definitions/schemas and exact omission inventories for 48,950 complete target records / 1,579,478 cells. Original identities, source-row/field references, raw ratio/rate values and masks permit auditing without duplicating whole raw tables.

High, mixed, primary and other excluded records remain outside the 154 profiles. Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles, coordinates and boundaries remain unknown. One year only; incompatible income measures and assessment thresholds cannot produce a common national ranking.
